thread:
mike: sec-bot alerted: S3 objects for snapshots missing SSE-C/CMK headers. ~2% of uploads in the last hour.
sec-bot: ALERT: object_missing_encryption_meta for bucket rdb-snapshots-prod. Sample keys: snapshots/tenant42/20260322/tar.gz
mike: noticed during backup compliance check. tagging eng-security.
cheng: on it, pulling uploader logs. @ana can you check recent deploys?
ana: checked — no infra deploys except uploader-service roll at 12:04 UTC. UPLOADER_ENCRYPT_MODE=SSE-C in config, but KMS_GRANT for uploader service account looks unset.
jamie: that smells like an RBAC prune. audit query: `protoPayload.methodName:SetIamPolicy AND resourceName:uploader-service-account` -> shows change at 12:01 by automation user rbac-pruner.
mike: ok, triage plan: (1) pause uploads, (2) reapply grants, (3) re-encrypt affected objects or re-upload, (4) postmortem. cheng, take lead?
cheng: taking it. pausing uploader now: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/maintenance/uploader?mode=pause` -> 12:12 UTC.
ana: applying KMS grant: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/backup/cryptoKeys/snapshotKey --member=serviceAccount:uploader@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`
jamie: grant applied at 12:15 UTC. verified new uploads include SSE-C and CMK headers.
mike: audit shows rbac-pruner removed grant at 12:01 (PR #482). Looks like pruning rule didn't exempt uploader SA.
cheng: options for remediation on already uploaded objects: (A) re-upload from source backups, (B) server-side re-encrypt to CMK using temporary grant. I prefer B to avoid re-ingesting.
nana: agree. I'll create a short-lived grant and run re-encrypt job with limited scope & TTL.
jamie: also add a blocking check: uploads without encryption headers should fail and page oncall. Add detection rule.
mike: +1. also create postmortem ticket and assign owners for the follow-ups.
sec-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #INC-20260322-01 Snapshot encryption header omission. Severity: P2.
cheng: follow-ups assigned: ana -> temp grant + re-encrypt script; jamie -> update IAM prune rule + add unit tests; mike -> postmortem writeup. I'll start re-encrypt run and report progress.
nana: re-encrypt started 12:30 UTC. scope: 120 objects. progress: 40%. early logs: `ERROR: object snapshots/tenant42/20260322/legacy.tar.gz: AccessDenied` — some legacy tenants use per-tenant CMKs, missing escrow grants.
mike: legacy CMKs need key-escrow grant path. paging sec-ops to re-provision temporary access. Mark those snapshots quarantined.
jamie: opened key-escrow request with ops at 12:38.
cheng: re-encrypt finished for 95 objects, 25 quarantined due to legacy CMK access. resuming uploads at 13:05 UTC.
nana: uploads resumed; new uploads include SSE-C and kms.encrypt audit entries. live monitoring shows no further missing-meta alerts.
mike: closing incident to monitoring. next actions: revert rbac-pruner rule change, add canary test covering uploader SA grants, add upload metadata validation to pipeline.
cheng: drafting runbook changes now, will add automated unit test and CI gate.
jamie: will block rbac-pruner until we have the gate.
mike: thanks all. :thumbsup: postmortem draft in #postmortems, link incoming.
sec-bot: NOTE: alert threshold updated to fail-fast on missing-encryption-meta.
